plugin.name: Translator
plugin.description: Translates as you type after “tr”, “fy” or “翻译” (“tr hello”, “tr ja good morning”, “tr en>zh apple”), with Google Translate’s web endpoint (MyMemory as the fallback), DeepL, Azure, Youdao, Baidu, your own HTTP engines or a local Ollama model. Text is sent only after one of these prefixes.
command.translate.title: Translate
command.translate.keywords: translate, translator, translation, tr, fy, deepl, google translate
pref.target.title: Translate into
pref.target.description: The language text goes into when the query names none. Automatic: the language of the interface, or English for text already in it (Simplified Chinese for English text in the English interface).
pref.engines.title: Engines
pref.engines.description: The engines asked, in order, one row each: deepl (DeepL API), azure (Azure AI Translator), youdao (Youdao AI Cloud), baidu (Baidu Translate) — each needs a key below and is skipped until it is set; google (Google Translate’s web endpoint: no key, not an official API, may stop working; usually unreachable in mainland China), mymemory (MyMemory by Translated: no key, about 5,000 characters a day, 50,000 with an email address); ollama (a local model, once one is chosen below: nothing leaves the computer). Your custom engines come after these unless you list them here as custom:Name. The text after the prefix is sent to each of them.
pref.fallback.title: Use MyMemory when the others fail
pref.fallback.description: When every engine above fails (no connection, quota exhausted), ask MyMemory instead.
pref.selection.title: Translate selected text at once
pref.selection.description: Shows the translation of the text selected in another app in the “Selected Text” section as soon as the launcher opens. This sends the selected text to the first engine before you pick anything, so it is off by default.
pref.deeplKey.title: DeepL API key
pref.deeplKey.description: From your DeepL account (the free plan has 500,000 characters a month; its keys end in “:fx”). Stored in the Windows Credential Manager or the macOS Keychain. With a key, DeepL is asked first.
pref.mymemoryEmail.title: Email address for MyMemory
pref.mymemoryEmail.description: Optional: MyMemory allows about 50,000 characters a day instead of 5,000 with a valid email address, which is sent with each request.
command.history.title: Translation History
pref.ollamaModel.title: Ollama model
pref.ollamaModel.description: A model of your local Ollama server to translate with, offline (e.g. qwen2.5 or llama3.1). Install Ollama and pull a model first; local models are slower than the web engines.
pref.ollamaURL.title: Ollama address
pref.ollamaURL.description: Where Ollama listens; its OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1/chat/completions) is used.
pref.customEngines.title: Custom engines
pref.customEngines.description: One engine per line: name | GET or POST | URL | JSON path of the translation [| body [| headers]]. {text}, {from} and {to} are filled in (escaped for the URL, a JSON body or a form). Example: My API | POST | https://example.com/translate | data.text | {"q":"{text}","target":"{to}"} | Authorization: Bearer KEY. Lines are stored in the configuration file, keys too: prefer engines with a key field above.
pref.history.title: Keep a translation history
pref.history.description: Records the translations you copy or paste (not what you type), on this computer only: never synced or sent. Turning it off deletes it.
pref.historyDays.title: Keep the history for
pref.clearHistory.title: Clear History
history.title: Translation History
history.off: The history is off. Turn it on in the translator’s settings.
history.empty: No translations yet. Translations you copy or paste are listed here.
pref.azureKey.title: Azure Translator key
pref.azureKey.description: A key of your Azure AI Translator resource (the free F0 tier has a monthly quota). Stored in the Windows Credential Manager or the macOS Keychain.
pref.azureRegion.title: Azure region
pref.azureRegion.description: The region of the resource, e.g. “eastasia”; leave empty for a global resource.
pref.youdaoAppKey.title: Youdao app ID
pref.youdaoAppKey.description: The application ID of a text translation app in Youdao AI Cloud (ai.youdao.com).
pref.youdaoSecret.title: Youdao app secret
pref.youdaoSecret.description: The app’s secret, used to sign requests; it is never sent. Stored in the Windows Credential Manager or the macOS Keychain.
pref.baiduAppID.title: Baidu Translate APP ID
pref.baiduAppID.description: From the Baidu Translate open platform (fanyi-api.baidu.com).
pref.baiduSecret.title: Baidu Translate secret key
pref.baiduSecret.description: Used to sign requests; it is never sent. Stored in the Windows Credential Manager or the macOS Keychain.
